thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P0 — host gpu-node-17 (rack-12) reported kernel panic + kubelet NotReady. Affected: inference-pool-prod, ~8 pods degraded. Alert: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD12345
Maria Chen: acked. I'm on it. pulling serial logs now.
Maria Chen: serial shows 'Kernel panic - not syncing: fatal exception' and nvme I/O errors right before oops.
Tim O'Neill: oncall handoff in 10 if you need escalation.
Maria Chen: starting cordon + drain for gpu-node-17 to move pods. likely we'll need to fallback to our standby GPU pool.
Kevin Patel: noted. I'll watch the autoscaler and GPU pool capacity. If pods can't schedule we'll trigger manual placement to gpu-standby.
Maria Chen: running:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```
Sara Gomez: FYI customer-facing routing shows increased 5xx for the /v1/generate route from 10:02-10:05. Estimated % of requests failing ~0.8% global, spiking for customers A and B.
Jordan Li: creating incident ticket in JIRA: INF-4321 and adding customer impact notes.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert acknowledged by Maria Chen.
deply-bot: (typo) ignore
Tim O'Neill: Maria, once drain completes, can you confirm no restarting pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff? we should avoid cascading restarts.
Maria Chen: drain still progressing, 6/8 pods evicted, 2 pods pinned due to local PVs — those are stateful KV-cache workers. Will trigger fallback for those two to standby pool.
Kevin Patel: setting manual placement temporarily:
```
kubectl patch pod inference-cache-2 -p '{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"pool":"gpu-standby"}}}'
```
Maria Chen: manual placement succeeded for cache pods. Eviction finished. Node is drained.
Tim O'Neill: great. Can you reprovision or reboot the host via the rack BMC? if NVMe errors persist we may need to reimage.
Maria Chen: triggered BMC reboot (ipmi sol). Serial log during reboot shows nvme errors > firmware timeouts. I spun down the node and put it into maintenance.
Sara Gomez: updated status page: "Degraded — some inference requests may see retries" with note we're shifting traffic.
Jordan Li: added customers A/B to priority notification list; outreach assigned to @CustomerSuccess.
Kevin Patel: autoscaler stable, standby pool absorbed ~95% of load. Latency increased ~120ms p95 for some model routes due to cold-cache.
Tim O'Neill: ok next steps: 1) keep node in maintenance 2) open hardware ticket for NVMe replacement 3) reimage and run burn-in in staging before returning to prod 4) postmortem. Anyone object?
Maria Chen: +1. I'll attach serial logs and dmesg to the ticket.
Jordan Li: assigned postmortem owner = Maria. Timeline and blast-radius analysis due EOD.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to Tim O'Neill (if not acknowledged) scheduled.
Tim O'Neill: taking oncall handoff now, marking for follow-up. Maria — ping me if NVMe swap confirmed so we can schedule return to service.
Sara Gomez: closing the customer impact window in the incident doc: 10:02–10:15 UTC, degraded but no data loss.
Maria Chen: closing thread here, switching to Jira for the remediation checklist. :white_check_mark:
